SELECT PAT_MASTER_INDEX.INP_NO 住院号, PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID ID, PAT_VISIT.VISIT_ID 住院次数, PAT_MASTER_INDEX.NAME 姓名, PAT_MASTER_INDEX.SEX 性别,
       floor( months_between(ADMISSION_DATE_TIME,PAT_MASTER_INDEX.DATE_OF_BIRTH)/12) 年龄,
       ID_NO 身份证,
       ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
       (SELECT dept_name FROM DEPT_DICT WHERE DEPT_CODE = DEPT_ADMISSION_TO)  入院科室,
       (SELECT START_DATE_TIME FROM ORDERS WHERE PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID AND VISIT_ID = VISIT_ID AND ORDER_CODE = 'LCSW001' AND ORDER_STATUS = '2') 死亡时间,
       (SELECT dept_name FROM DEPT_DICT WHERE DEPT_CODE = DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM)  出院科室,
       DIAGNOSIS_NO 诊断序号, DIAGNOSIS_CODE 诊断代码, DIAGNOSIS_DESC 诊断名称
       ,TEST_NO,(SELECT RESULT FROM LAB_RESULT A WHERE A.TEST_NO = LAB_TEST_MASTER.TEST_NO) RESULT
      --CASE WHEN PAT_MASTER_INDEX.PATIENT_ID = '? THEN '? ELSE '' END AS CT号
FROM PAT_VISIT INNER JOIN PAT_MASTER_INDEX ON PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID = PAT_MASTER_INDEX.PATIENT_ID
               INNER JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON DIAGNOSIS.PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID
                                   AND DIAGNOSIS.VISIT_ID = PAT_VISIT.VISIT_ID
               LEFT JOIN LAB_TEST_MASTER ON LAB_TEST_MASTER.PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID
                                        AND LAB_TEST_MASTER.VISIT_ID = 0
                                        AND SPECIMEN = '咽拭子'
                                        AND SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME > DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - 3
               LEFT JOIN EXAM_MASTER ON EXAM_MASTER.PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID
                                    AND EXAM_MASTER.VISIT_ID = 0
                                    AND EXAM_MASTER.EXAM_CLASS = 'CT'
                                    AND REQ_DATE_TIME > DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - 3
WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME > comm.F_TODATE('?)
  AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < comm.F_TODATE('?)
  AND DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION = '3'

SELECT PAT_MASTER_INDEX.INP_NO 住院号, PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID ID, PAT_VISIT.VISIT_ID 住院次数, PAT_MASTER_INDEX.NAME 姓名, PAT_MASTER_INDEX.SEX 性别,
       floor( months_between(ADMISSION_DATE_TIME,PAT_MASTER_INDEX.DATE_OF_BIRTH)/12) 年龄,
       ID_NO 身份证,
       ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
       (SELECT dept_name FROM DEPT_DICT WHERE DEPT_CODE = DEPT_ADMISSION_TO)  入院科室,
       (SELECT START_DATE_TIME FROM ORDERS WHERE PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID AND VISIT_ID = VISIT_ID AND ORDER_CODE = 'LCSW001' AND ORDER_STATUS = '2') 死亡时间,
       (SELECT dept_name FROM DEPT_DICT WHERE DEPT_CODE = DEPT_DISCHARGE_FROM)  出院科室,
       DIAGNOSIS_NO 诊断序号, DIAGNOSIS_CODE 诊断代码, DIAGNOSIS_DESC 诊断名称
       ,TEST_NO,(SELECT RESULT FROM LAB_RESULT A WHERE A.TEST_NO = LAB_TEST_MASTER.TEST_NO) RESULT
      --CASE WHEN PAT_MASTER_INDEX.PATIENT_ID = '? THEN '? ELSE '' END AS CT号
FROM PAT_VISIT INNER JOIN PAT_MASTER_INDEX ON PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID = PAT_MASTER_INDEX.PATIENT_ID
               INNER JOIN DIAGNOSIS ON DIAGNOSIS.PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID
                                   AND DIAGNOSIS.VISIT_ID = PAT_VISIT.VISIT_ID
               LEFT JOIN LAB_TEST_MASTER ON LAB_TEST_MASTER.PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID
                                        AND LAB_TEST_MASTER.VISIT_ID = 0
                                        AND SPECIMEN = '咽拭子'
                                        AND SPCM_SAMPLE_DATE_TIME > DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - 3
               LEFT JOIN EXAM_MASTER ON EXAM_MASTER.PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID
                                    AND EXAM_MASTER.VISIT_ID = 0
                                    AND EXAM_MASTER.EXAM_CLASS = 'CT'
                                    AND REQ_DATE_TIME > DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME - 3
WHERE DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME > comm.F_TODATE('?)
  AND DISCHARGE_DATE_TIME < comm.F_TODATE('?)
  AND DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION = '3'

i.name as 姓名,
i.sex as 性别,
i.inp_no as 住院号,
(select dept_name from dept_dict where dept_code=v.dept_admission_to) as 入院科室,

        WHERE ADMISSION_DATE_TIME BETWEEN comm.F_TODATE('?) AND comm.F_TODATE('?)
        AND instr(PATIENT_ID,'_')=0 )

       floor( months_between(ADMISSION_DATE_TIME,PAT_MASTER_INDEX.DATE_OF_BIRTH)/12) 年龄,
       ID_NO 身份证,
       ADMISSION_DATE_TIME 入院时间,
       (SELECT dept_name FROM DEPT_DICT WHERE DEPT_CODE = DEPT_ADMISSION_TO)  入院科室,
       (SELECT START_DATE_TIME FROM ORDERS WHERE PATIENT_ID = PAT_VISIT.PATIENT_ID AND VISIT_ID = VISIT_ID AND ORDER_CODE = 'LCSW001' AND ORDER_STATUS = '2') 死亡时间,

       DIAGNOSIS_NO 诊断序号, DIAGNOSIS_CODE 诊断代码, DIAGNOSIS_DESC 诊断名称

  from (select (select aa.dept_name
                  from dept_dict aa
                 where aa.dept_code = al.ward_code) operator_dept,
               (select name
                  from staff_dict bb
                 where bb.emp_no = b.in_operator_no) in_operator_no,
               count(1) ru,
               0 as chu
          from pat_visit a, pat_visit_new b, adt_log al
         where a.patient_id = b.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
           and a.patient_id = al.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = al.visit_id
           and al.action = 'C'
           and a.admission_date_time > comm.f_todate('?)  
           and a.admission_date_time <  comm.f_todate('?) 
           and in_operator_no  is not null
           and operator_dept = '?
         group by b.in_operator_no, al.ward_code
        union all
        select (select aa.dept_name
                  from dept_dict aa
                 where aa.dept_code = al.ward_code) out_operator_dept,
               (select name
                  from staff_dict bb
                 where bb.emp_no = b.out_operator_no) out_operator_no,
               0 as ru,
               count(1) chu
          from pat_visit a, pat_visit_new b, adt_log al
         where a.patient_id = b.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
           and a.patient_id = al.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = al.visit_id
           and al.action = 'F'
           and a.discharge_date_time >  comm.f_todate('?)  
           and a.discharge_date_time <  comm.f_todate('?) 
           and out_operator_no is not null
           and out_operator_dept = '?
         group by al.ward_code, b.out_operator_no) 
 group by operator_dept  order by operator_dept

create table INSUR_EXPORT.化验记录表 as(
select 
       case when a.visit_id ='0' then (select cc.clinic_no
                   from outp_treat_rec s,outp_orders cc
                  where a.test_no = s.appoint_no and s.serial_no = cc.serial_no  and rownum =1)
                  else a.patient_id||a.visit_id end as 唯一就诊标识,
       a.patient_id as 就诊标识,
       a.test_no as 化验单号,
       decode(a.visit_id,'0','门诊','住院') as 就诊类别,
       a.spcm_received_date_time as 采样时间,
       a.spcm_sample_date_time as 接收时间,
       c.result_date_time as 化验时间,
       a.results_rpt_date_time as 报告时间,
       a.name as 病人姓名,
       d.id_no as 身份证号码,
       (select ks.dept_name from dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.Ordering_Dept) as 开单科室,
       (select ks.dept_name from dept_dict ks where ks.dept_code=a.PERFORMED_BY) as 执行科室,
       b.item_code as 套餐包编码,
       b.item_name as 套餐包名称,
       c.REPORT_ITEM_CODE as 详细化验项目编号,
       c.REPORT_ITEM_NAME as 详细化验项目名称,
       c.result as 化验结果,
       c.print_context as 参考区间

from lab_test_master a
join lab_test_items b on a.test_no=b.test_no
join lab_result c on b.test_no=c.test_no and b.item_no=c.item_no and a.test_no=c.test_no
join pat_master_index d  on a.patient_id=d.patient_id
join  INSUR_EXPORT.信息表 dd  
  on dd.检查检验申请号=a.test_no and dd.检查检验申请号=b.test_no and dd.检查检验申请号=c.test_no
   and (trunc(结算日期)>=to_date('?,'yyyy-mm-dd')
and trunc(结算日期)<to_date('?,'yyyy-mm-dd')))

select a.科室, sum(a.术前平均住院日), sum(a.术后平均住院日)
  from (select (select aa.dept_name
                  from dept_dict aa
                 where aa.dept_code = a.operating_dept) 科室,
               sum(CEIL(a.start_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) 术前住院时间,
               sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) 总住院日,
               CEIL(sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) /
                    sum(CEIL(a.start_date_time - b.admission_date_time))) 术前平均住院日,
               0 as 术后住院日,
               0 as 总住院日,
               0 as 术后平均住院日
          from operation_schedule c, operation_master a, pat_visit b
         where c.patient_id = a.patient_id
           and c.visit_id = a.visit_id
           and a.patient_id = b.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
           and c.ack_indicator = 1
           and b.discharge_date_time >= comm.f_todate('?)
           and b.discharge_date_time < comm.f_todate('?)
         group by a.operating_dept
        union all
        select (select aa.dept_name
                  from dept_dict aa
                 where aa.dept_code = a.operating_dept) 科室,
               0 as 术前住院时间,
               0 as 总住院日,
               0 as 术前平均住院日,
               sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - a.end_date_time)) 术后住院日,
               sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) 总住院日,
               CEIL(sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - b.admission_date_time)) /
                    sum(CEIL(b.discharge_date_time - a.end_date_time))) 术后平均住院日
          from operation_schedule c, operation_master a, pat_visit b
         where c.patient_id = a.patient_id
           and c.visit_id = a.visit_id
           and a.patient_id = b.patient_id
           and a.visit_id = b.visit_id
           and c.ack_indicator = 1
           and b.discharge_date_time >= comm.f_todate('?)
           and b.discharge_date_time < comm.f_todate('?)
         group by a.operating_dept) a
 group by 科室

SELECT DEPT_DICT.TJ_KSMC,
       Sum(nvl(ADM_OUTP_NUM, 0) + nvl(FROM_OTHER_HOSPITAL_NUM, 0) + nvl(CANCEL_DISCHARGE_NUM, 0)) IN_NUM,
       sum(nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_RECOVER, 0) + nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_EFFECT, 0) +
           nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_INVALED, 0) + nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_DIED, 0) +
           nvl(DISCHARGE_DISPOSITION_OTHER, 0))                                                   OUT_NUM,
       nvl(OPER_NUM.QTY, 0)                                                                       OPER_NUM
FROM DEPT_DICT
         LEFT JOIN DEPT_ADT_DAY ON DEPT_DICT.DEPT_CODE = DEPT_ADT_DAY.DEPT_CODE
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT TJ_KSMC, QTY
                    FROM (SELECT TJ_KSMC, QTY
                          FROM (SELECT TJ_KSMC, count(*) QTY
                                FROM (SELECT B.DEPT_NAME                   TJ_KSMC,
                                             (SELECT OPERATION
                                              FROM (SELECT E.PATIENT_ID,
                                                           E.VISIT_ID,
                                                           listagg(E.OPERATION, ' || ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY E.OPERATION) AS OPERATION
                                                    FROM OPERATION_NAME E
                                                    GROUP BY E.PATIENT_ID, E.VISIT_ID)
                                              WHERE PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID
                                                AND VISIT_ID = A.VISIT_ID) OPERATION_NAME
                                      FROM (SELECT A.START_DATE_TIME,
                                                   A.PATIENT_ID,
                                                   A.VISIT_ID,
                                                   (CASE
                                                        WHEN (SELECT count(1)
                                                              FROM LEND_BED_LOG
                                                              WHERE DEPT_CODE <> LEND_DEPT_CODE
                                                                AND PATIENT_ID = A.PATIENT_ID
